data.description:
## Context
Change 1275 (ticket f1eb-b967-c1de-4ffa) ports the golden-path probe to
scripts/probe_rebar.py and re-points every consumer, but the Gerrit
Verified gate executes gerrit-verify.yaml from MAIN's workflow definition
against the patchset tree — so the change had to keep a transitional
scripts/probe-rebar.sh exec shim for main's still-shell golden-path step
to invoke (patchset 1 failed golden-path with exit 127).

## Plan
Once change 1275 merges (main's golden-path step then runs
`python scripts/probe_rebar.py` directly), delete scripts/probe-rebar.sh.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] scripts/probe-rebar.sh removed from the tree
- [ ] No workflow, script, doc, or test references probe-rebar.sh
  (grep -r "probe-rebar" over the repo is empty outside CHANGELOG history)
- [ ] gerrit-verify golden-path job green on the deleting change itself
  (proves main's definition no longer needs the shim)

## File impact
- scripts/probe-rebar.sh (delete)
data.title: Delete transitional probe-rebar.sh shim
